source: Heizspiegel München 2018, Vergleichswerte für das Abrechnungsjahr 2016 (co2online gGmbH for the Referat für Gesundheit und Umwelt, Landeshauptstadt München)
file: Heizspiegel_Muenchen_2018_Abrechnungsjahr_2016_web.pdf (Wayback Machine copy of 2024-04-16 of www.heizspiegel.de/fileadmin/hs/khsp/muenchen/; local copy in ~/EnergyMapData/heizspiegel/)
page: PDF page 4 (printed pages 6-7), table 'Der Heizenergieverbrauch Ihres Gebäudes'
unit: kWh per m² living area and year, space heating + hot water, centrally heated residential buildings

definitions.area: Wohnfläche des gesamten Gebäudes (also labelled beheizte Wohnfläche, Nutzfläche or Gebäudefläche on the bill)
definitions.hotWater: included for buildings with central hot water; buildings without central hot water add 24 kWh/m² before comparing
definitions.fuelConversion: 1 litre heating oil or 1 m³ natural gas = 10 kWh when the bill does not state kWh
definitions.sizeClasses: 100-250, 251-500, 501-1.000, >1.000 m² living area of the whole building
definitions.bands: günstig < low; mittel low to below the mean; Ø = mean; erhöht above the mean to high; zu hoch > high. The leaflet does not state which percentiles the limits correspond to.
definitions.weather: actual consumption of the billing year; the leaflet mentions no weather correction
